messages.text: Marcus Webb — Night Security Guard, Valcourt BioLabs. On duty the night Dr. Rask disappeared.
Detective. Look, I already told the officer who came by — I didn't see anything wrong that night. Nothing on my end looked out of place.
I know how it looks that the Level 3 corridor feed cut out right around then. I swear that camera's been glitchy for weeks. I put in two maintenance requests myself.

choices.text: Walk me through exactly what you saw before the feed dropped.
Did you notice anything unusual outside the building that night?

msg-205a.text: Dr. Rask walked past my desk around 9:40, same as most nights. A couple minutes later someone else came through — didn't sign the visitor log, didn't stop at my desk either. Feed dropped not long after that. I figured it was just the camera again. I didn't think to flag it until the morning.

msg-205b.text: Actually, yeah — there was a van idling in the service lane out back for a while. Unmarked, no plates I could see from my window. I almost called it in but it pulled out before I could get a good look.

msg-206.text: I should've said something sooner. I didn't want to lose my job over a busted camera. If that feed dropping is connected to whatever happened to him, I want to help however I can.
